chapter: Small's Paradise, Fletcher Henderson and Horace
title: The saxophone as the bastard instrument and classical saxophonists
summary: Caldwell recalls old masters calling the saxophone a bastard instrument, and discusses Rudy Wiedoft and recitalists; Dance dislikes the classical sound.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
